name: russia-2026-10
description: Model of reported Russian behaviours as of 2026-10: QUIC Initial SNI filtering with residual blocking, banned hosting prefixes, a TCP byte cutoff behind some CDNs, UDP DNS hijack.

rules.note: 198.51.100.0/24 stands for a mass-banned hosting prefix.
connection freezes after about 16-20 KB, no RST; 198.18.0.0/15 stands for non-whitelisted sites behind CDNs. Not applied 24/7 in reality.
QUIC v1 Initial SNI on any UDP port, 420 s residual block per 4-tuple; node.lab.example stands for a blocklisted name.
